title: Guided Engineering Acceptance Criterion Schema
description: Single Given/When/Then acceptance criterion. Verifiable condition for a requirement.

acceptanceCriterionId.description: Stable identifier. Lowercase letters, digits, dots, underscores, hyphens.

given.description: Pre-condition or context. The state of the world before the action.

when.description: The action or event under test.

dataExamples.description: Concrete input/output examples that make the criterion unambiguous.
